topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Mornin', neighbor. Ye come askin' 'bout usin' a patch o' our yard fer yer garden, is that right? Now, this piece o' land, it's been part o' my life since I was a lad. Seen it through dry spells and floods, watched the soil give and take with each turn o' the season. I reckon it's more than just dirt to me. But, if ye're short on space, might be right to lend a hand. Just need to think on it, weigh the crops we've planned, see how the saints smile on this year's weather. Tell ye what, why don't ye come by after the church bells toll vespers, we'll talk more then. Till then, pray for clear skies; looks like storm clouds brewin'.
